hints.title: Maintaining Reachable Contiguous Prefix Range
hints.text: Maintain the invariant that all values in the interval from 1 up to miss minus one can already be formed by some subset sum.

hints.title: Greedy Doubling on Coverage Deficit
hints.text: If the next available array element exceeds miss or the array is exhausted, adding miss itself is the optimal patch that doubles the reachable range.

hints.title: Linear Sweep Range Expansion
hints.text: Initialize miss to 1 and patches to 0. While miss <= n, if index < len and nums[index] <= miss, absorb nums[index] by miss += nums[index]; else patch by miss += miss and increment patches.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal greedy solution running in O(M + log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Knapsack subset sum searches take pseudo-polynomial or exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval coverage expansion resolves reachability without testing individual sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prevent integer overflow by using 64-bit integers for the miss accumulator.
